text: Ɓee lunndiiɓe, hiɓe fawii ka ɓe woondirana on Alla, onon gomɗimɓe ɓen, si on ruttitike e maɓɓe, fii fellintinangol on ngantooje maɓɓe mehreɗe ɗin, fii tun wata on feluɓe. Tertoreeɓe tertagol tikkere, taccon ɓe. Pellet, koɓe soɓirɓe nder. Jaaƴorde maɓɓe nden nde ɓe ñiiɓoyta on e mun, njobdi faggitanɗe maɓɓe ɗen immorde e naafiqaaku e bakkaatu, ko Jahannama.
